shared_elements: large rectangular recessed inscribed panel cut into a cliff face
horizontal registers/rows of inscribed text filling the panel
small figural scene in the upper register of the panel
rectangular niches cut below the panel containing eroded standing figures
vertical framing borders/pilaster-like edges flanking the panel
rough uncarved rock surface below the carved zone
justification: Both surfaces show the identical scheme of a tall recessed rock-cut panel filled with many horizontal lines of inscription, crowned by a small figural scene, flanked by vertical framing edges and set above niches holding eroded standing figures with rough rock beneath — an arrangement far too specific to arise independently. The only differences are of viewpoint and legibility: B is closer so the text rows and top figures are visible, while A's wider framing includes more of the cliff and both flanking niches.
